Ladakh LG Inaugurates Facilities in Kargil

Ladakh Lieutenant Governor R.K. Mathur inaugurated a farmers' hostel and reviewed agriculture facilities in Kargil. He also inaugurated an automated driving testing centre in the region. The visits focused on improving agricultural infrastructure and road safety measures.
